title: TEDA Team
description: Team members grouped into three sections — Leadership Team, Internal Team, International Support Team — each a grid of photo (or initials), name linking to their full bio, role, a short bio and social links. Shows a designed empty state until at least one member is categorised.

count.description: Max members shown per section (Leadership / Internal / International Support), not a total across all three.
